messages:
Anna (eng-runtime): FYI, urgent perf issue after the chat_v2 canary. Observed an enormous spike in KV misses tied to prefix keys.
Jordan (eng-sre): Seeing it too. cache-proxy p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~840ms, backend QPS doubled, several pods restarted. Snapshot:
```
proxy: fanout=10 misses=18k/min backend_latency_ms=820
kvstore: read_replicas: error=503 hot_queue=5200 reclaim_rate=high
```
OpsBot: Deployment event: chat_v2 canary ramp by @anna at 1765123310 (canary=30%)
Priyam (eng-ml): Root cause hypothesis: recent kernel-selection change (prefer 'fast_reduce' for mid-length sequences) unintentionally altered batching profiles. More small-batch executions -> more granular KV lookups. Also noticed a change in prefix normalization in packaging that reduced key entropy.
Liam (runtime-profiler): Repro on staging with warmup stream. Tokenization edge-cases produced many near-duplicate prefixes that were non-canonical, causing unique key count to jump from ~900k -> ~4.1M in ~6m.
Anna (eng-runtime): Emergency mitigation applied: disabled prefetch/warmup for the affected pool (flag: prefetch_warmup=false) and halted the canary ramp. That throttled backend pressure.
Jordan (eng-sre): Also applied proxy fanout limiter for service chat-v2 group. API call used:
```
POST $OPS_API/services/chat-v2/config -d '{"max_fanout":2}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
Priyam (eng-ml): Short-term code rollback plan: pin kernel-selection to the previous small-batch path (kernel=v1-small) for nodes serving chat_v2 until we fix canonicalization and batching heuristics.
Anna (eng-runtime): Pinned kernel on canary and pushing a small client-side normalization patch to trim tokenizer artifacts (strip "," padding tokens and normalize multiple spaces) before keying.
Maya (product): Any customer impact? Support saw a few latency tickets and one Dedicated tenant reported increased 500s.
Anna (eng-runtime): Confirmed: 4 support tickets, one Dedicated tenant with elevated error rates. Incident comms drafted in #customer-success.
Liam (runtime-profiler): After mitigations (first 10m): prefix hit-rate climbed from 24% -> 77%, backend QPS returned to baseline, proxy p95 down to ~230ms. Still below ideal but stable.
Jordan (eng-sre): Action items: 1) full postmortem, 2) add prefix warmup QoS (cap warmup fanout per-prefix), 3) CI tests: deterministic key-canonicalization checks, 4) add canary scale ramp guard for kernel-selection changes.
Anna (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. ETA: initial postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow, canonicalization fix in next minor deploy, long-term: warmup isolation + hierarchical read-replicas in Q2.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-2026-0421-7 (sev=P1)  assignees: @anna, @jordan, @priyam
Jordan (eng-sre): :thumbsup: closing triage channel. Ping here immediately if anything spikes.
